meta.library_note: 21 midstream construction modules (pipeline spreads, crossings, valve sites, stations, terminals, processing, controls, line fill and in-service), authored by VissRad. Demonstration norms, not market or benchmark data: calibrate to your own history before a plan is issued.

event.name: 52-Mile Gas Transmission Lateral and Compressor Station (synthetic demo)

units.name: Mainline valve sites and pig traps

materials.desc: Field joint coating kit (two-part epoxy or shrink sleeve)
CP anode bed and rectifier materials
Station piping, 12 in average, with fittings

modules.name: Spread mobilization and pipe yards
modules.desc: Mobilize the spread: execution plan and permits, spread office, pipe and contractor yards, pipe receiving and stockpiling, equipment move-in and the right-of-way access plan.

tasks.desc: Execution plan, permits and spread safety plan
Receive and stockpile line pipe ({JOINTS} joints)

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Pipeline spread, mainline section
modules.desc: One section of cross-country mainline, built by the crews that follow each other down the right-of-way: survey and environmental controls, clear and grade, haul and string, bend, weld, NDE, coat, ditch, lower in, pad and backfill, tie-ins, hydrotest, clean-up and restoration.

queries.prompt: Mainline welders on the firing line

tasks.desc: Survey, stake and environmental controls ({MI} mi)
NDE of mainline welds (AUT or radiography)
Field joint coating and holiday test

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Horizontal directional drill crossing
modules.desc: Rivers, highways, wetlands and other no-touch crossings: rig up with entry and exit pits and mud recycling, pilot hole, ream and swab, fabricate and test the pull section, pull back, then rig down and restore.

tasks.desc: Rig up, entry and exit pits and mud system
Fabricate and test the pull section
Rig down and restore the work areas

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Road and rail bores
modules.desc: Conventional auger bores under roads and railroads, cased or uncased: bore pits, bore and case, push the carrier pipe, end seals and test leads, and pit backfill.

tasks.desc: Push carrier pipe, end seals and test leads

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Open-cut water and wetland crossings
modules.desc: Streams and wetlands crossed by open cut, dam-and-pump or flume: access mats, isolation, ditch, set the pre-built crossing section with weights, backfill and restore the banks.

tasks.desc: Lower in the section with weights

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Mainline valve sites and tie-ins
modules.desc: Block valve sites along the line: site work and fence, set the mainline valve and its bypass and blowdown, actuators and gas-over-oil operators, tie-ins to the mainline, test and RTU at the site.

queries.prompt: Remote-operated (RTU and power at the site)?

tasks.desc: Valve site grading, aggregate and fence
Set mainline valve, bypass and blowdown
Test and coat the valve site piping

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Pig launchers and receivers
modules.desc: Launcher and receiver barrels at the ends of each pigging section: set the traps, kicker and bypass piping, closures and pig signalers, then test.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Cathodic protection and AC mitigation
modules.desc: Corrosion protection for the line: deep or shallow anode beds and rectifiers, test stations, insulating joints, AC mitigation where the line parallels power lines, and the close-interval survey.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Station site, foundations and yard
modules.desc: Site work for compressor, pump, meter or terminal stations: clear and grade, stormwater and access road, compressor and equipment foundations, pipe supports, aggregate yard and fence.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Compressor units
modules.desc: Gas turbine or reciprocating compressor units at a mainline or booster station: set the packages, bush and shim, assemble, pre-align and final align, with lube oil and the OEM checks.

tasks.desc: Expedite, receive and stage compressor packages

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Station piping, headers and gas cooling
modules.desc: Station yard piping: suction and discharge headers, unit piping, gas coolers, filter separators and scrubbers, station bypass and blowdown, with supports, hydrotest, painting or insulation.

tasks.desc: Set gas coolers and filter separators

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Station buildings
modules.desc: Compressor or pump building with its overhead crane, control and electrical building, auxiliary and warehouse buildings: steel and shell, crane, building systems and fire and gas detection.

queries.prompt: Overhead crane in the compressor building?

tasks.desc: Building HVAC, lighting and fire and gas detection

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Meter and regulator station
modules.desc: Custody transfer or interconnect meter station: filter separator, ultrasonic or orifice meter runs, flow computers, gas chromatograph, pressure regulation and overpressure protection, and the station building.

tasks.desc: Set filter separator, meter skid and building

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Liquids pump station
modules.desc: Crude, products or NGL pump station: mainline pumps and motors, booster pumps, strainers and the pressure control valve, the relief system and sump: bush and shim, set, pre-align, connect piping and final align.

tasks.desc: Expedite, receive and stage pumps and motors
Bush, shim and level pump bases

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Terminal storage tanks
modules.desc: Field-erected floating-roof or fixed-roof tanks at a crude or products terminal: bottom, shell courses fit and tack, weld, roof, nozzles and manways, attachments and stairs, hydrotest and close-up.

tasks.desc: Fit and tack bottom and shell courses
Nozzles, manways and floating roof seals

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Terminal loading and manifolds
modules.desc: Truck or rail loading racks, the marine dock manifold where there is one, tank manifolds, transfer pumps, vapor combustion and the custody meters at the racks.

tasks.desc: Loading arms, meters and vapor recovery
Tank manifolds and terminal piping ({LF} ft)

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Modular gas processing plant
modules.desc: A modular cryogenic gas processing plant or NGL fractionation train: inlet and amine treating, mole sieve dehydration, cold box and turbo-expander, residue compression and the product pumps, set as shop-built modules and interconnected in the field.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Station electrical
modules.desc: Utility service or on-site generation, the station substation and MCC / power distribution center, cable tray, power and control cable to motors and drivers, grounding and lighting.

queries.prompt: Station substation (electric-driven units or large pumps)?

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Station controls, SCADA and leak detection
modules.desc: Station PLC and unit control panels, field instruments, emergency shutdown and fire and gas, the communications to the pipeline control center, SCADA points and the leak detection system, with loop checks and point-to-point tests.

tasks.desc: SCADA point-to-point with the control center

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Pre-commissioning and station turnover
modules.desc: Station systems from construction to operations: walkdowns and punch lists, flushing and drying, nitrogen purge and leak test, ESD and fire and gas function tests, and system turnover packages.

tasks.desc: ESD and fire and gas function tests
Clear punch and turn over systems

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Line fill, start-up and in-service
modules.desc: Put the line and stations in service: caliper and geometry pig runs, gas-up with purge or liquid line fill, station unit start-ups with the OEM, the baseline in-line inspection run where required, and the stable-flow period before handover.

tasks.desc: Station unit start-ups with the OEM ({UNITS})
In service and handover to pipeline operations

modules.author: VissRad
